title: Fresh Fruit Tart with Vanilla Crème Pâtissière
summary: A crisp sweet pastry case filled with vanilla crème pâtissière and topped with strawberries, kiwi and berries under an apricot glaze.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Crème pâtissière
steps.text: heat the milk with 70 g of the sugar and the salt to a simmer. Whisk the yolks with the remaining sugar and the cornflour until pale, whisk in the hot milk, return to the pan and whisk over medium heat until it thickens and bubbles for 30 s; it should pass 85 °C. Off the heat, whisk in the butter and vanilla, cover the surface and chill 3 h.

steps.title: Pastry
steps.text: beat the yolk with the cream. Pulse the flour, icing sugar and salt, pulse in the butter to coarse crumbs, then add the yolk mix and process until it just clumps. Press into a disc, wrap and chill 1 h.

steps.title: Line
steps.text: roll between 2 sheets of baking paper to a 33 cm round, ease into the tin, trim and freeze 30 min. Heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan).

steps.title: Bake the case
steps.text: line with paper and beans, bake on the tray 25 min, remove the paper and beans and bake 8-10 min more until golden all over. Cool completely. A fully baked, golden case stays crisp under the cream.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: whisk the cold crème pâtissière smooth and spread it in the case. Arrange the strawberries round the edge, then rings of kiwi, raspberries and blueberries towards the centre. Pat the fruit dry first so juice does not run into the cream.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: warm the jam with the water, sieve, and dab gently over the fruit. Chill 30 min before slicing.

tips: A common mistake is filling a warm case, which melts the cream; let it cool fully.
Use fruit that is ripe but firm.
Assemble on the day of serving for the crispest pastry.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep in the fridge and eat within 1 day. The pastry cream keeps for 2 days and the baked case for 1 day in an airtight tin.
